atoms.1: Poison ivy itself is not contagious between people.
atoms.2: The rash caused by poison ivy is known as contact dermatitis.
atoms.3: The rash results from an allergic reaction to urushiol, an oil found in the plant.
atoms.4: Urushiol can be transferred from one person to another if it remains on the skin, clothing, or other surfaces.
